## Parental OpControl 0.17.27

- **Beta badge.** The dashboard sidebar now labels the version box **VERSION** with a **BETA** badge, and the About page marks the server version as **BETA** with a short note that Parental OpControl is in beta. The sidebar copyright line now reads **© 2026 OpControl · License**.
- **Simpler footer.** The page footer no longer repeats the “Built with AI” paragraph (it stays on the About page). The whole “CREATED BY OpControl” block is now one keyboard-focusable link to **/about**, with a small “Click for app info and credits” line.
- **Real system resources.** Each device card now shows live CPU, RAM, disk, battery and uptime instead of placeholder gauges: battery state and percentage, uptime as “3 d 4 h”, and “Updated … ago”. When the device is not reporting the card says **Offline · last seen …**; a greyed-out Temperature gauge says **Coming soon**.
- **Reporting cadence.** While a parent has the Devices page open the client reports every 30 seconds; otherwise every 5 minutes. The dashboard tells the device through the existing SignalR hub, and no process names or network data are collected.
- **Peak warnings.** The server records one warning per episode: CPU or RAM at 90% or more for 2 minutes, disk free below 10%, and battery at 10% or less while not charging. The Devices page lists each device’s warnings for the last 30 days with start time, peak value and duration.
- **Optional warning alerts.** A new family setting, **Alert me about device warnings** (off by default), sends the normal parent alert and push when a warning starts. Warnings are always recorded on the Devices page.
- Both themes, phone width and English/es-MX are covered.
